What you need to do by hand:
- Phone (B10 and B30): I put your number under (C), meaning cell or mobile, because I can't tell what kind of number it is. If it's a work or home landline, move it to the (W) or (H) slot in both places.
- Email (B11): your email address isn't in the details I have. Write it in yourself, or leave it blank if the preschool doesn't need it.
- Preschool name (title and B08): add the name of the preschool or daycare.
- Relationship (B12): if the form has room, the note "applying on behalf of the child's mother" makes it clear why an aunt is applying. Some preschools still want a parent's signature or a short consent note from your sister, so it's worth asking them.
- You can shorten your name in B30 to just MARICEL ESCALANTE if the line is too short.
